newsitem.title: UK: Hickson sells PharmaChem to Warner-Lambert.
newsitem.headline: Hickson sells PharmaChem to Warner-Lambert.

text.p: British chemicals firm Hickson International Plc said on Thursday it agreed to sell its Hickson PharmChem Ltd (PharmaChem) unit to U.S. firm Warner-Lambert Co for 28.5 million stg cash.
Hickson said it expected to record a small, non-operating exceptional profit on the deal, after accounting for costs and goodwill expenses of 1.2 million stg previously written off to reserves.
PharmaChem, which operates on a 35-acre site at Ringaskiddy, Ireland, specialises in the manufacture of chemicals for the drug and healthcare markets.
Hickson said it would use proceeds from the sale to reduce debt.

"The sale of PharmaChem represents another significant element of our asset disposal programme aimed at restructuring the group's portfolio of businesses and strengthening our balance sheet," Hickson said in a statement.
Hickson's shares firmed 4.0p to 75.5 by 1320 GMT.
Regarding its own results, Hickson reiterated that trading to date is meeting expectations.
"The board remains confident of further improvement in operating performance for the year as a whole," the firm said.
